newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: OAU secretary-general condemns Sierra Leone coup.
newsitem.headline: OAU secretary-general condemns Sierra Leone coup.

text.p: Organisation of African Unity Secretary-General Salim Ahmed Salim on Monday condemned soldiers who overthrew Sierra Leone's government, saying they were undermining Africa's transition to democracy.

Salim, who was at a Zimbabwe preparatory meeting ahead of an OAU summit in Harare next week, told reporters he was taken aback by the military takeover in the West African state and urged the continent to condemn Sierra Leone's new leaders and not to welcome them into OAU ranks.
"I hope the OAU summit will take a strong stance against this move and help Sierra Leone move back to constitutional and democratic rule," he said.

"It is lamentable that some soldiers who have no mandate to rule at all should decide to challenge the legitimate position of the people. It is a setback for Africa's transition to democracy," Salim said.
